title: Clients
descriptionAll: All agency clients, their status and account managers.
newDescription: Add a client and set their account manager and team. Default folders and a general conversation are created automatically.
emptyBody: Add your first client to start managing their files and messages.

form.companyHint: Arabic and English name, logo and industry.
form.logoAfterCreate: You can upload the logo after the client is created.
form.accountHint: Status, account manager and assigned team.
form.teamHint: Assigned staff can see the client's files and messages when their access is “assigned clients”.
form.notesHint: Team only — never shown to the client.

noPackageBody: Package items and delivery progress will appear here.
recordUsageHint: Log delivered items manually until deliverables feed usage automatically in Phase 3.
quantityHint: Use a negative number to correct.

users.title: Portal users
users.description: Who can access the client portal, their roles, and who can approve.
users.inviteTitle: Invite a user to the {client} portal
users.inviteDescription: They'll receive an invitation email valid for 7 days.
users.canApproveHint: Can approve designs and content once approvals launch.
users.emptyBody: Invite the client's team to access the portal.
users.deactivateBody: They won't be able to sign in to the portal until reactivated.
users.changeInviteEmailBody: The current invitation link stops working and a new invitation goes to the new address with the same role and approval right.
users.modeDirectHint: The new address works right away. Their other sessions end, the old address gets a notice naming you, and the new address gets a confirmation.
users.modeConfirmHint: A link goes to the new address (valid for 48 hours). Nothing changes until they open it.
users.inviteEmailChanged: A new invitation was sent to {email}
users.existingBody: {name} already has a portal account (clients: {clients}). Add them to {client}?
users.existingBodyNoClients: {name} already has a portal account. Add them to {client}?
users.alreadyHere: This person already has access to this client.
users.teamMember: This address belongs to an agency team member. Team members can't be added as portal users.
users.searchHint: Type a name or an email. Existing portal users appear as you type.
users.addThatUserInstead: Add that user to this client instead
users.clientsDescription: Every client this person can access, with their role and approval right there.
users.onlyThisClient: You see only this client's access.
users.noMoreClients: This person already has access to every client you manage.
users.removeFromClientBody: They lose access to {client} right away. Their other clients aren't affected.
users.accountBody: Deactivating the account blocks sign-in for every client. Their client memberships are kept.
users.deactivateAccountBody: They can't sign in to any client until the account is reactivated.
users.adminEmptyBody: Invite users from a client's page → Portal users.
users.loadFailed: Couldn't load this user. Try again.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: Monthly service packages and what they include. Assigned to each client for a period.
packages.priceHint: Optional, visible to the team only.
packages.activeClients: {count, plural, =0 {No current clients} one {# current client} other {# current clients}}
packages.emptyBody: Create a package to define what a client gets each month.
